versions.changelog:
Initial release of feishu-im Skill.

- Provides 25+ Feishu IM and group management capabilities, including message sending, group creation, PIN/retract/urgent actions, menu/Tab/announcement management, and more.
- Comprehensive API references and best practices for all key IM and group operations.
- Details required permissions for all supported features.
- Includes practical implementation notes and error code explanations.
- Supports advanced functions such as feed cards, group widgets, and real-time data sync.
